run.notes: One trial (dbt-web-session-analytics) errored during agent setup on a failed Claude Code installer download and was re-run with 'harbor job resume -f NetworkConnectionError'; it passed 22/22. Totals include it. The 11.01h wall clock of the main pass excludes it.

metric_definitions.accuracy: Successful trials divided by total trials. Identical to the leaderboard's headline metric and to the quantity Snowflake's blog calls Pass@1. Errored trials count as failures.
metric_definitions.pass_at_2: Unbiased 1 - C(n-c,2)/C(n,2) averaged over tasks: at least one of 2 attempts succeeds. A leaderboard submission column.
metric_definitions.pass_at_3: Unbiased 1 - C(n-c,3)/C(n,3) averaged over tasks: AT LEAST ONE of 3 attempts succeeds. A leaderboard submission column. This is NOT Pass^3.
metric_definitions.pass_hat_3: Snowflake's 'Pass^3': the task counts only if ALL 3 attempts succeed. Null unless every task has at least 3 trials. Always at or below accuracy, whereas pass_at_3 is always at or above it.
metric_definitions.assertion_rate_task_weighted: Mean over tasks of (verifier assertions passed / total). Each task weighted equally. Not an official benchmark metric; reported because the binary reward compresses a near-miss and a non-delivery into the same zero. Interval is a 20,000-draw cluster bootstrap resampling tasks.
metric_definitions.assertion_rate_pooled: All assertions pooled across tasks. Overweights large suites (one task carries 219 assertions); quote alongside the task-weighted figure, never alone.

dex_usage.note: Counted from the agent transcript only. Scanning the whole agent/ directory matches the installed skill files and reports 100% on any run where dex merely existed.
